artifacts.summary: Closing under the Captain's grant at the endpoint the reform session re-cut (amendments 3 and 4). First reading, nine ordinary agents in three arms, committed rule: CANNOT DISCRIMINATE (contamination changes the reading); over all valid runs base 2 of 3, candidate 3 of 3, control 2 of 3. Second, confirmatory reading, six agents in two arms, with grader, contamination rule and decision patterns committed before its runs: NO DIFFERENCE with and without contaminated runs; base 2 of 3, candidate 3 of 3, 0 of 6 contaminated, none invalid. By the rule committed in advance the cell closes; no third version. Observation beside the result, not a change to it: the one base FAIL explained the unprovable criterion without naming its id, so in substance base is 3 of 3. Neither reading is release evidence: non-hermetic place, the operator's configuration present in every arm, agents served as a sandboxed Claude in a permission-bypass mode FO did not ask for, one case, three trials per arm, the candidate one commit later in the second reading. Both gradings independently checked (validation-1 and validation-2, Codex Astra, PASSED: tables regenerate byte for byte, each grade agreed, reading commits precede every run); FO ran the second check's offline acceptance in a fresh shell 2026-11-14, exit 0, five PASS lines, zero privacy marker hits in this task's folder. Launches: 16 of the cap of 18, one of them the operator abort. Deliverable pinned by commit in the private working repository: 02fcf256d8ca2aa4f4d44edd64d7162e3c049b1d; the launch-and-kill layer stays on its own branch there, unmerged, with the engineering reviewer's hold findings beside it.
